name: Cybernetic Spider (Dr. Michael Kelly)
incarnation: PlayStation 1997; same Dr. Michael Kelly protagonist with the default Slasher front-leg attachment.
scope: Only the Kelly base protagonist sprite; no Electro-Beam or Flamethrower slot changes.

auxiliaryEvidence.observations: The primary manual states Slash is the basic front-leg weapon and weapons attach to the two front legs. Its visible body diagrams and gameplay images are too small; page14–15 lists weapons without a clear Slasher model.
The 35.75-second 640x480 gameplay clip confirms the small organic arachnid body and crawling/climbing context. The Slasher blade, face implant and complete limb geometry remain too small to resolve.

verifiedIdentityFacts: The existing dome robot sprite is not a faithful visual authority.
The source protagonist is an organic/cybernetic arachnid with an abdomen and cephalothorax, not a humanoid or armored robot dome.
Default Slash/Slasher is a front-leg attachment; promotional cover firearm is not evidence for the selected base loadout.
unresolvedVisualDetails: Complete eight-leg geometry and leg attachment layout across animation angles.
Precise Slasher blade shape, proportions and implantation, including its relation to ordinary front legs.
Palette difference between blue promotional cover lighting and brown/gray in-game model.

independentSourceReview.summary: Independent reviewer viewed both source rasters and the gameplay contact sheet. A cautious body anchor is possible, but full anatomy/angles and the default Slasher are not sufficiently locked to approve a faithful4x4 sheet.

requiredEvidence: A readable native game close-up, model turnaround, or original diagram showing the complete default Slasher spider, face/implant and its leg attachments. It must be retrieved and viewed before any regeneration.
decision: No generation or installation. Keep the old image unchanged as an existing variant; do not substitute a generic spider or invent missing source detail.
